s1_ban_text.entry_B_object_clause_verbatim: a GLOBAL periodic-orbit search of a rescaled flow with no fixed point nearby to seed it

s2_function_space.compactified_profile_closed_form: (1 - X)  [an exact linear zero at X=1]

named_mechanism: THE LOG-PERIODIC BLOCK'S REGULARITY DEFECT IS AN INVARIANT OF THE ENTRANCE, NOT A PROPERTY OF THE DOMAIN'S FAR END. The compactification X = |y|/(1+|y|) that makes the Type-I profile's norm FINITE carries the far-field block r^{-1+i*kappa} to (1-X)^{1-i*kappa} -- the identical functional form to clause (a)'s recorded gCLM difficulty X^{1-iy}, at the opposite end of the domain. Seeding dissolves all four of leg 260's sec 3.4 reasons; it does not dissolve this, because this is not a statement about the seed.
